## Central question

How sensitive is Korean equity momentum to universe selection, rebalancing, and transaction costs?

## Hypothesis

Examine whether a past-return ranking contains information about subsequent returns. No hypothesis has been tested yet.

## Data plan

Define a point-in-time equity universe, price and volume data, corporate-action adjustments, and delisting treatment. Record sources and usage rights.

## Methodology plan

Specify lookback and holding periods before testing. Compare the strategy with appropriate benchmarks and separate development and evaluation periods.

## Robustness and limitations

Test universe changes, turnover, transaction costs, liquidity screens, and subperiod stability. Address survivorship bias and look-ahead bias.

## Results

Pending data collection and analysis. No performance results are available.
